attchmntText: Cupid Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation Q2 and H1 FY 27
voiceSummary: Cupid Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The company reported H1 FY27 revenue from operations of 342.58 Crores, a 137% year-on-year increase. Total income stood at 365.95 Crores. EBITDA was 114.83 Crores with a margin of 33.5%. Profit after tax reached 100.37 Crores, up 156% year-on-year. Exports contributed 112.73 Crores, while domestic revenue was 224.64 Crores. The company raised its full-year FY27 guidance to at least 880 Crores in revenue and 275 Crores in net profit. The presentation was uploaded to the company website at https://www.cupidlimited.com/.

attchmntText: Cupid Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "Press Release   Q2 and H1FY27 Financial Results".
voiceSummary: Cupid Limited filed a press release regarding its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results for the period ended 30th September 2026. The company reported H1 FY27 net profit of ₹100.37 Crore, a 156% year-on-year increase, with total income rising 136% to ₹365.95 Crore. Q2 FY27 net profit grew 133% year-on-year to ₹56.22 Crore, while total income increased 132% to ₹208.97 Crore. Cupid raised its FY27 revenue guidance to at least ₹880 Crore and net profit guidance to ₹275 Crore plus. The company also provided medium-term guidance, projecting FY28 revenue of at least ₹1,305 Crore and net profit of approximately ₹390 Crore, and FY29 revenue of at least ₹1,950 Crore with net profit of approximately ₹605 Crore. Cupid announced partnerships with Style Baazar and V2 Retail, and stated its Palava manufacturing facility is scheduled for commissioning in Q3 FY27.

attchmntText: Cupid Limited has informed the Exchange about Conversion of up to the total outstanding 56,00,000 Warrants, in one or more tranches, into an equivalent number of Equity Shares of Baazar Style Retail Limited.
voiceSummary: Cupid Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 18,786.19 lakhs for the quarter and 34,257.69 lakhs for the half year. Standalone profit after tax was 5,622.45 lakhs for the quarter and 10,038.67 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 0.42 for the quarter and 0.75 for the half year. The board also proposed conversion of 56,00,000 outstanding warrants in Baazar Style Retail Limited into equity shares at 328.25 rupees per share. This conversion is within the previously approved investment of 1,01,00,000 warrants. The financial results were reviewed by Chaturvedi Sohan and Co.
